risks.trigger: A positive reservation succeeds and claimMusic rejects before a workflow starts. Add-audio also throws on a null claim outside the cleanup wrapper.
risks.observedContract: Both claim calls are outside the later trigger cleanup; the created hold has no explicit cleanup on this exceptional path.
risks.validation: Source and AST comparison only. Existing tests cover a null primary CAS result and trigger failures; a real-D1 claim-rejection reproduction was not added or run.
risks.impact: The new hold may remain reserved after the caller fails. Eventual expiration/reconciliation behavior was not verified; no claim of permanent balance loss.
risks.proposedSeparateFix: Guard the new-hold interval from claim through dispatch, cleaning only a hold this call owns. Keep callbacks after successful dispatch outside pre-dispatch cleanup; test rejection, null claim and already-started cases.

risks.trigger: A long shot exceeds the default/minimum quoted duration and no longer seedance edit duration raises the quote.
risks.observedContract: Smart estimates a model-default duration; add-video estimates 5 seconds. Payloads retain shot duration, and motion execution snaps that duration.
risks.validation: Four isolated pure-estimator probes cover the duration and reference cases. This does not execute the two orchestration functions or an actual supplier bill.
risks.proposedSeparateFix: Compare the same resolved/snap duration used by dispatch, including edit lower bounds, draft semantics and dialogue costs; keep per-item and batch hold ownership unchanged.

risks.trigger: A start-frame smart retry includes real references, or add-video has a location-only reference-only shot.
risks.observedContract: Smart omits hasReferenceImages; add-video derives it from characters/elements but not location references. Dispatched request references can select a different endpoint.

syntheticProbe.rates: Synthetic i2v/t2v 1000 versus r2v 2000 microdollars per 1000 tokens.

risks.validation: Pure estimateVideoCost probes with referenceOnly=false and true; no provider calls or claim that every provider routes or prices the same way.
risks.proposedSeparateFix: Project endpoint-affecting references from the actual per-shot motion request before pricing, while retaining route refusals, snapshot shape, claims and reservation boundaries.
